doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: PWA icons stored in public/icons/ directory. Required sizes: icon-192.png (Android home screen), icon-512.png (Android splash), maskable-icon.png (Android adaptive). Favicon.ico in public/ root. PWA manifest at app/manifest.ts using Next.js native support.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Native PWA support via manifest.ts added in fall 2024. Use Next.js metadata API for iOS meta tags (appleWebApp configuration) rather than manual meta tags.

story-context.constraints:
**Development Constraints:**
1. **Icon File Location:** All icon files must be stored in public/icons/ directory (per architecture.md lines 96-101). Favicon.ico must be in public/ root.
2. **Next.js 16 Best Practices:** Use Next.js metadata API for iOS meta tags (appleWebApp configuration in layout.tsx) rather than manual meta tags in head block. Violating this is an architecture violation (ADR-001).
3. **PWA Manifest Configuration:** manifest.ts must export a function returning MetadataRoute.Manifest type. Use native Next.js PWA support (no external manifest.json file needed).
4. **Icon Requirements (from tech-spec-epic-4.md):** - 192x192 PNG (purpose: "any") - Android home screen (required) - 512x512 PNG (purpose: "any") - Android splash screen (required) - 512x512 PNG (purpose: "maskable") - Android adaptive icon with 80% safe zone (required) - 180x180 PNG - iOS apple-touch-icon (already referenced in layout.tsx:19) - favicon.ico - Multi-size favicon (16x16, 32x32, 48x48)
5. **Maskable Icon Safe Zone:** Maskable icons must keep content within 80% safe zone (40px padding on 512px canvas) to prevent clipping on different Android launcher shapes. Test with https://maskable.app
6. **Theme Color Consistency:** theme_color in manifest.ts must match app's color scheme. Based on layout.tsx line 41 (className="dark") and architecture.md, the app uses dark mode with monochrome storm theme. Set theme_color: '#000000' (black) to match.
7. **No Custom Splash Screens:** iOS automatically generates splash screens from icon and theme colors. Custom splash screens not required for MVP (per tech-spec-epic-4.md Open Questions).
8. **Build Verification:** After icon changes, verify Next.js build succeeds with no warnings. Icons must be optimized for web (PNG format, reasonable file sizes).
9. **Testing Strategy:** Comprehensive device testing deferred to Story 4-7 (cross-browser testing). Story 4.5 focuses on basic verification (Lighthouse PWA audit, visual inspection of icons).
10. **No New Dependencies:** Use existing tools (Sharp for icon generation if needed). Do not add new icon generation libraries.

tests.standards:
**Testing Standards for Story 4.5:**
Based on architecture.md and tech-spec-epic-4.md, icon testing should verify:
1. **Icon File Verification:** - All required icon files exist at correct paths in public/icons/ - Files are optimized PNG format with reasonable file sizes - Icons render clearly without distortion at specified sizes
2. **PWA Manifest Validation:** - manifest.json (generated from manifest.ts) serves correctly at /manifest.json - Icons array includes all required sizes with correct paths - Theme colors match app color scheme
3. **Lighthouse PWA Audit:** - Run Lighthouse audit on development or production build - Verify "Installable" criteria passes - Confirm manifest includes all required icon sizes (192x192, 512x512 minimum) - Fix any icon-related warnings
4. **Visual Inspection:** - Favicon displays correctly in browser tabs - Icons appear crisp and clear at actual sizes - Maskable icon safe zone compliance verified with https://maskable.app
5. **Deferred Testing (Story 4-7):** - iOS home screen icon appearance (Safari Add to Home Screen) - Android home screen icon appearance (Chrome, Samsung Internet) - Maskable icon adaptation on various Android launchers - Theme color integration with device OS (status bar, app switcher)
**Testing Framework:** Manual verification + Lighthouse PWA audit (no automated unit tests needed for icon files)
tests.locations: - Icon files: public/icons/ directory - Favicon: public/favicon.ico - Manifest configuration: will-it-rain/app/manifest.ts - iOS metadata: will-it-rain/app/layout.tsx (metadata.appleWebApp, metadata.icons) - Lighthouse audit: Run against development build (npm run build && npm run start)

**AC-2: Icon is recognizable and matches app branding** - Test Idea: Design simple icon related to rain/weather theme (umbrella, cloud, raindrop) - Test Idea: Verify icon works on both light and dark backgrounds - Test Idea: Confirm icon is clear and recognizable at small sizes (48x48 or smaller)
**AC-3: Splash screen displays while app loads (iOS)** - Test Idea: Verify apple-touch-icon.png (180x180) exists - Test Idea: Confirm layout.tsx metadata.icons.apple references correct path - Test Idea: Verify iOS appleWebApp metadata is configured (already done in layout.tsx) - Deferred to Story 4-7: Manual testing on iOS device
**AC-4: Theme colors integrate with device OS** - Test Idea: Set theme_color in manifest.ts to match dark mode (#000000) - Test Idea: Set background_color in manifest.ts (white or app background) - Test Idea: Add themeColor to layout.tsx metadata - Deferred to Story 4-7: Verify integration on real devices
**AC-5: Maskable icons adapt to device requirements (Android)** - Test Idea: Create maskable-icon.png (512x512) with 80% safe zone compliance - Test Idea: Test icon with https://maskable.app for safe zone verification - Test Idea: Set purpose: "maskable" in manifest.ts icons array - Deferred to Story 4-7: Verify adaptation on Android launchers
**AC-6: Favicon displays correctly in browser tabs** - Test Idea: Create favicon.ico (multi-size: 16x16, 32x32, 48x48) - Test Idea: Place favicon.ico in public/ root - Test Idea: Verify favicon displays in Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge tabs
**AC-7: All icon sizes render clearly without distortion** - Test Idea: Visual inspection of all generated icons at actual sizes - Test Idea: Verify icon clarity at 192x192, 512x512, 180x180, and favicon sizes - Test Idea: Run Lighthouse PWA audit to confirm icon requirements met
